recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7219 unless the work group wants a broader editorial change to where Observation.interpretation explanatory prose is stored.
issue_request: FHIR-7219 was a Published FHIR-core Observation change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to add "abnormal flag" as an alias for Observation.interpretation and to add text explaining that interpretation is intended as a simple compact code often placed adjacent to the result value in reports and flow sheets to signal result meaning/normalcy.
initial_application: Git history shows the request was applied in 54f14f427c6d24a74a89a58246d2f25abce02fc4, which added the Abnormal Flag alias and requested compact-code/normalcy text to source/observation/observation-spreadsheet.xml. Later source migrations, including 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 and c69d71aa213de86d55e0261339c15e4bacd509e6, carried the content into the current StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: Observation is active in the current build according to source/fhir.ini. The current source stores the requested explanatory sentence in the Observation.interpretation comment rather than the definition, while keeping the Abnormal Flag alias. FHIR-18156 later corrected a typo in the same sentence and is already represented on the combined branch by 8e8dcfde92093e961967c0efb9ded2b0b445af24.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml already conveys the requested alias and abnormal-flag/normalcy guidance. Moving the text back into the definition would not change implementer understanding and would undo later editorial structure.

related_jiras.note: A later Published core issue corrected a typo in the same Observation.interpretation sentence; it supports the current wording and is already audited on the combined branch.
